description: Uplink Latency and Radio-KPI Dataset for Multi-Connectivity Evaluation in Commercial 5G Networks (ULR-MC5G) is a data set described in the paper "Uplink Latency and Radio-KPI Dataset for Multi-Connectivity Evaluation in Commercial 5G Networks (ULR-MC5G)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Carlos S. Alvarez-Merino, Miguel Villanueva-Fernandez, Alejandro Ramirez-Arroyo and colleagues. Commercial fifth-generation (5G) networks are increasingly considered for latency-sensitive applications such as remote monitoring, teleoperation, and autonomous mobility. However, public datasets that jointly expose packet-level latency, packet loss, radio-layer measurements, mobility information, and dual-operator multi-connectivity (MC) traces remain limited. This article describes a processed dataset collected over commercial 5G Non-Standalone networks in Aalborg, Denmark, using a vehicle-mounted dual-modem measurement platform. Coverage: commercial 5G networks. The data are held on IEEE DataPort, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support latency-sensitive remote operation and network performance studies. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
